title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Supreme
desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Rum
desc: After a heist, Shiva and his crew hide out in an abandoned bungalow. However, they are soon haunted by spooky occurrences.

title: Hit List
desc: Vijay's life turns into a living hell when a mysterious masked figure abducts his family. Forced into a dark world of violence, he becomes an unwilling assassin, targeting the kidnapper's enemies.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.

title: Kondraal Paavam
desc: The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.

title: Pandi Oliperukki Nilayam
desc: Valarmathi, a girl from a wealthy family, falls in love with Pandi, who rents out sound systems for various occasions. When they are set to get married, an accident changes the course of their lives.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs made by various music producers and artists is played back-to-back.

title: Kuri
desc: While visiting Bibin, a lottery winner, for official purposes, a policeman accidentally gets trapped in Bibin's house with the people who try to loot him.

title: Velaikkaran
desc: Arivazhagan, a slum dweller, works in a large food company. However, when he realises that they adulterate the food, he strives to fight them.
